status: Declared before research target audit and model fitting
dataset: PhysioNet BIG IDEAs Lab Glycemic Variability and Wearable Device Data
splitMethod: Fixed source-participant-disjoint split. All windows of a participant remain in one partition. Small convenience cohort; not a representative external clinical validation.
targetAuditRule: Use glucose >=180 mg/dL at +120 minutes only if train has >=200 positive windows, >=5% prevalence and positives in >=5 train participants; otherwise use observed glucose rise >=20 mg/dL by +120 minutes if >=100 positive windows across >=5 train participants; otherwise disable classification pending adequate data.
targetAuditScope: Train participants only before selection/calibration/test labels are inspected.
modelSelection: Regression family selected by mean participant +120-minute MAE; classifier by mean participant Brier on selection participants only. Run the same fixed families for CGM-only, wearable-only, matched research context+wearable, synthetic EHR-only, and unmatched composite EHR+wearable ablations.
primaryModelSelection: Choose among CGM-only, wearable-only and matched research context+wearable by selection +120-minute MAE. Unmatched synthetic EHR never selects the deployed research predictor.
calibration: Separate calibration participants; Platt probability mapping and 90th percentile absolute residual bands per horizon. One scalar threshold maximizing F1 on calibration only, with precision/recall and prevalence reported; no promise of clinical utility or >=80% recall.
missingness: No backward fill or future interpolation. CGM last observation available within15min (three cadence intervals); HR aggregate uses only completed source-minute timestamps. Invalid IBI removed with counts and adjacent differences only within10s; derived RMSSD requires >=20 accepted differences.
preFitClarification: Before fitting or label audit, maximum CGM carryforward clarified from10 to15minutes because grid timestamps can already lag the latest source observation by up to5minutes. This supports two-missing-reading tests without using future data.
testRule: Test labels are evaluated once after chosen artifact, calibration and threshold are frozen. No retuning on test results.
uncertaintyLimit: Only two calibration and three final participants. Residual bands are empirical, not a guarantee under participant dependence or distribution shift.
syntheticContext: Genuine Synthea sample profiles are deterministically and arbitrarily paired without wearable/target-based matching; they are not the same people and cannot validate physiological EHR fusion.
